name: accountable
description: Accountable: a sales CRM, the first part of a business OS

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "uv run uvicorn accountable.main:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/accountable" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.types: uv run python -m accountable.openapi frontend/openapi.json && npm run types -w frontend
scripts.types:check: uv run python -m accountable.openapi frontend/openapi.json && npm run types:check -w frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend e2e scripts .claude/hooks playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:py
scripts.format:check:web: prettier --check frontend e2e scripts .claude/hooks playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:web: eslint --max-warnings 0 frontend e2e scripts .claude/hooks playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:e2e && npm run test:web && npm run test:py
